## Checklist

- [ ] Linked issue exists and already has a done checklist, a milestone, and one
      of `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `chore`, `spike`
- [ ] Branch name is `<type>(<domain>)/<number>-<slug>`
- [ ] Pull request title is `<type>(<domain>): #<number>: <description>`
- [ ] Title is imperative and at or below 72 characters
- [ ] This pull request is intended to merge with **Squash and merge**; the PR
      title is the final squash commit title
